pages.name: Home
pages.description: Your computer, at a glance.

pages.name: Appearance
pages.description: Make Sovel feel like your space.

pages.name: Wallpaper & Lock Screen
pages.description: Backgrounds, secure locking and sign-in preferences.

items.label: Idle locking
items.detail: Automatic locking needs an integrated idle service. The secure Lock Now action remains available.

items.label: Greeter preserved
items.detail: This update does not replace or reconfigure the login screen.

pages.name: Desktop & Dock
pages.description: A dock that fits the way you work.

items.label: Pin and arrange apps
items.detail: Right-click an app in App Library to pin it. Drag pinned icons to reorder them. App Library stays last.

pages.name: Menu Bar & Control Center
pages.description: Choose what belongs in your menu bar.

pages.name: Widgets & Search
pages.description: A useful desktop, with your data under your control.

items.label: Location stays your choice
items.detail: Weather uses a city you choose. It does not request your automatic location.

items.label: Local search
items.detail: Settings search and App Library search work locally. No web search or file-content indexing is silently enabled.

pages.name: Displays & Graphics
pages.description: Connected screens and the graphics hardware driving them.

items.label: HDR and variable refresh
items.detail: These controls require an exposed, supported compositor and display interface.

items.label: Night light
items.detail: Color-temperature controls require an integrated color service.

pages.name: Sound
pages.description: Outputs, microphones, app routing and audio tests.

items.label: Live controls
items.detail: Output, Input, Applications and Advanced share one audio service.

pages.name: Bluetooth & Devices
pages.description: Your paired devices and connected hardware.

items.label: Friendly names
items.detail: Paired devices can be renamed. Battery levels appear when the device reports them.

items.label: Cameras and controllers
items.detail: Device-specific controls appear when a supported tool is installed.

pages.name: Keyboard & Input
pages.description: Comfortable typing, pointing and multilingual input.

items.label: Sovel shortcuts
items.detail: Super+Shift+S: region screenshot. Super+J: JARED. Super+I: Settings. Super+E: Files. Super+L: lock.

pages.name: Printers & Scanners
pages.description: Printing and scanning through installed device services.

items.label: Device availability
items.detail: Only devices and capabilities reported by the installed printing/scanning services are shown.

pages.name: Network & Internet
pages.description: Connect, discover networks and manage connection profiles.

pages.name: Sharing & Remote Access
pages.description: Make remote access an explicit choice.

items.label: Remote desktop
items.detail: Remote desktop requires an installed, configured server with authenticated access.

pages.name: Notifications & Focus
pages.description: Quiet when you need it; visible when it matters.

pages.name: Apps & Defaults
pages.description: Installed apps, default handlers and startup preferences.

items.label: Add-only policy
items.detail: All existing Store listings remain available. Store removal operations remain disabled.

pages.name: Power & Battery
pages.description: Power profiles and hardware-supported energy information.

items.label: Hardware support
items.detail: Profiles are supplied by the installed power service; no performance claim is inferred from a profile name.

items.label: Charging limits
items.detail: Charge thresholds are shown only when the device exposes a supported charging interface.

items.label: Hibernate
items.detail: Hibernate needs configured swap and resume support.

pages.name: Storage & Disks
pages.description: Capacity, volumes and deliberate cleanup.

items.label: Review before deleting
items.detail: No downloads, caches, duplicate files or partitions are deleted automatically.

pages.name: Users & Accounts
pages.description: Your local identity and authenticated account changes.

items.label: Local account
items.detail: No Sovel cloud account, remote family sync or device-tracking service is simulated.

pages.name: Language & Region
pages.description: Language, fonts and composition support.

items.label: Multilingual coverage
items.detail: Noto Sans, CJK and Emoji plus the installed Fcitx5 input engines remain available.

pages.name: Date & Time
pages.description: System time, synchronization and regional formats.

items.label: Administrator approval
items.detail: System clock changes use the authenticated system time service.

pages.name: Accessibility
pages.description: Comfortable contrast, motion, text and input.

pages.name: Gaming & Performance
pages.description: Real performance information and installed game tools.

items.label: Frame overlays
items.detail: Overlays require an installed and integrated tool such as MangoHud.

pages.name: Screen Time & Family
pages.description: Personal usage information without hidden tracking.

items.label: No simulated family controls
items.detail: Remote family sync, website filtering and app blocking are not presented as protections without an enforcing backend.

pages.name: Privacy & Security
pages.description: Understand the protections actually available.

items.label: Permission boundary
items.detail: Sandboxed applications use portal and Flatpak permissions. Unrestricted native applications are not protected by cosmetic permission switches.

pages.name: JARED & Voice
pages.description: Local conversations and explicit action permissions.

items.label: Text and speech output
items.detail: Text conversations and offline spoken replies are available. Voice recognition and wake phrases are not silently enabled.

pages.name: Backup & Recovery
pages.description: Keep recovery deliberate and verifiable.

items.label: System snapshots
items.detail: Automatic system rollback is shown only when a supported snapshot backend is installed and configured.

items.label: Installation media
items.detail: Reinstallation and disk formatting require explicit target selection. This page never erases a drive as a casual action.

pages.name: SOVEL Update
pages.description: Signed updates, clear release identities and real history.

items.label: Stable release channel
items.detail: Only the configured signed public channel is offered; unavailable Beta and Developer channels are not simulated.

pages.name: Developer Options
pages.description: Inspect development tools and services without hidden elevation.

items.label: Explicit authorization
items.detail: Service, account, firewall and system-time changes require authenticated backends. Arbitrary shell execution is not exposed by this page.

pages.name: About SOVEL
pages.description: The identity, hardware and software behind this device.

widgets.snapToGrid.label: Snap widget placement to a 16-pixel grid
